regime_context: The detector shows Base Metals & Copper as the momentum leader with moderate durability (0.71, mixed trend), while the rotation is broad (88% eligible) and no single narrative dominates. The absolute-trend gate has historically helped manage drawdowns, but cross-sectional momentum has no forward return edge. This note offers conditional, accountable leans derived from trend-gate eligibility and durability — all at low conviction given the detector's constraints and the market's high unscheduled-surprise share.
emerging_watch: Silver & Royalties is the closest challenger to Base Metals (margin 0.43). Retire the watch if Base Metals' score widens to >0.6.

theses.subject: Gold Miners
